name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai is an AI "Conversational Knowledge Engine" that automatically transcribes meetings, interviews, and conversations into searchable summaries with action items, decisions, and speaker identification.
best_for: Sales teams needing automatic follow-ups and CRM sync, educators wanting lecture transcripts and summaries, media/interview transcription, recruiting teams, and any organization needing structured conversation documentation.
features: Automatic real-time transcription across multiple languages (English, French, Spanish, Japanese, German, Mandarin)
AI-generated meeting summaries with decisions and action items
AI Chat to search across meetings and connected apps
Bot-free desktop recording on Mac/Windows without a bot joining the call
Speaker recognition identifying who said what
Channels for organizing meetings by team, project, or topic
Integrations with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: A connected workspace that includes AI-powered meeting notes alongside documents and project tracking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want meeting notes to live alongside their broader knowledge base and task tracking.

alternatives.name: Zoom
alternatives.description: A video-meeting platform with a built-in AI assistant that generates call summaries and next steps.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that primarily need transcription/summaries within the video platform they already use.

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, and Microsoft 365 integration.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations already on Microsoft 365 wanting meeting capture inside their existing chat/meeting tool.
